title: DevHarness Gate Review Verdict Output
description: Producer output contract for DevHarness review gates that pass, request changes, or block implemented work.

outcome.description: Producer must emit the single enum value that reflects the completed stage state. Report missing help through the runner non-blocking stop control channel, never as an output outcome.
outcome.x-usage: Treat this as the authoritative workflow state for this output. Do not infer success from other populated fields when it requires revision.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the relevant decision or handoff in concise human-readable form without adding new scope.
summary.x-usage: Use this as concise human-readable context only. Do not route, approve, or expand scope from this text.

evidence_checked.description: Producer must list the concrete sources, artifacts, commands, or state inspected before issuing the verdict.
evidence_checked.x-usage: Use this as the list of sources actually checked before the verdict. Do not assume any unlisted source or surface was checked.

findings.description: Producer must list actionable findings, concerns, or reasons behind the verdict; leave empty only for a clean pass.
findings.x-usage: Treat these as the actionable reasons behind the verdict. Apply them when the outcome requires rework; do not use them to add unplanned scope.

verdict.description: Producer must emit the review decision payload, including summary, checked evidence, and findings supporting pass, rework, or block.
verdict.x-usage: Use this with outcome as the authoritative decision. Pass only on passed, send changes only on needs_changes,. Report missing help through the runner control channel without completing the step.

required_implementation_steps.description: Producer must list implementation branch ids that must rerun when review requires rework.
required_implementation_steps.x-usage: Use only these branch ids when rerunning implementation for required changes. Do not add branches from prose alone.

artifacts.description: Producer may emit named structured artifacts created by this stage when they are part of the handoff.
artifacts.x-usage: Use these only as supporting named artifacts to preserve or pass along. Do not treat them as routing decisions unless another field explicitly references them.

results.description: Producer may emit compact structured results, decisions, or evidence summaries created by this stage.
results.x-usage: Use these as supporting evidence or compact summaries. Do not let them override outcome, selected steps or approved contracts.
